fields.name: userId
fields.description: OIDC sub of the script's author. Scripts are per-user — every user has their own library per (projectId, envSlug).

fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Owning Project.ItemId. Scripts are env-scoped: one row per (userId, projectId, envSlug, name).

fields.name: envSlug
fields.description: Environment slug (dev / stg / prod / uat / custom). Same env scope as VerificationTarget and Secret.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name. Unique within (userId, projectId, envSlug) — the editor's dropdown identity.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free-text description shown in the editor's dropdown.

fields.name: language
fields.description: javascript (the only supported language today; the column exists so a future switch to TypeScript / Python doesn't require a schema migration).

fields.name: code
fields.description: Script body. Plain JavaScript — runs in the Node context via `new Function` wrapper inside mcp-server's runScript helper. The user calls Playwright APIs on the injected `page` arg and uses the injected `log(level, msg)` / `screenshot(label)` helpers to emit console_log / screenshot_taken SSE events.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent save. Echoed on update so the localStorage mirror can compare freshness.
